description: Run to learn which tokens a wallet holds and how much. Ranked by USD value; unverified (often spam airdrop) tokens are flagged so you don't report fake holdings. Lists a wallet's tokens (SPL Token and Token-2022) with exact amounts, whether each is verified, and USD value where priced. Example: {"wallet": "<address>", "how_many": 10}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/tokens.

how_many.description: How many tokens, highest USD value first, to return. Default 25.

include_empty.description: Include empty token accounts. True only to find empty accounts, e.g. to close them.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

wallet.description: The wallet to read the tokens of. The user's address (from their wallet app) or your agent's public key. Not a .sol name or ticker.

name: tokens
